# Friday Startup

> Friday Startup supports founders and businesses through venture building, growth partnerships, business recovery support and business automation. AI innovation is a future direction.

## Current services

- Venture building: explore customer needs, shape a focused digital venture, consider a useful first version and learn before adding complexity.
- Growth partnerships: work on positioning, go to market foundations, customer acquisition experiments, customer journeys and retention opportunities.
- Business recovery support: understand what is driving a business challenge and explore relevant digital, product or process options. Recovery and financial outcomes are not guaranteed.
- Business automation: discuss business workflows and whether a bounded automation approach is suitable. People remain involved in decisions that need judgment. Scope is confirmed directly; no specific outcome is promised.

## Future direction

- AI innovation: exploring useful AI product ideas and possible digital ventures.
